about:
# Mail Steward

Review and mail chosen stacks from Daylight with the shared Steward decision.

For **World of Warcraft: Forever** (interface 16001).

- Daylight mailbox panel with whole-stack selection and visible recipients.
- Shared K/V/A/B decisions and configurable auction threshold from Bag Steward.
- Remembered bank recipient, blank-field defaults, and existing draft protection.

## Requirements

DaylightUI

Optional integrations: BagSteward, ItemTree, Auctionator, TradeSkillMaster, DisenchantValue, Disenchantry.

## Controls

/outmail; /om

## Installation

Install through CurseForge or extract the ZIP into your Forever Interface/AddOns folder. Keep the packaged folder name `DaylightOutgoingMail` unchanged; this also preserves existing saved settings. Enable the listed dependencies.

## Publishing

Push a stable annotated version tag matching the TOC, such as `v1.1.1`, to publish. GitHub Actions validates the source and packages a GitHub release; the connected CurseForge native packager handles the CurseForge Release file through its push webhook. No CurseForge publishing token belongs in this repository or its Actions secrets.

## Feedback

[Report an issue](https://github.com/bhuddleston42/MailSteward/issues) with the addon version, expected behavior and Lua error if available.

## Testing

Release packaging and Lua syntax are checked automatically. Included regression tests use simulated game APIs. Real gameplay and combinations of third-party addons can expose additional issues; please report them.

## Credits

Includes the [Mailworthy](https://github.com/sjdodge123/mailworthy) engine by Jake Dodge under the MIT license; see LICENSE and UPSTREAM.md.
